```{python}
#| include: false
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
```


## Exercise 1

```{python}
flights = pd.read_parquet("data/flights.parquet")
flights.info()
```

1. How many flights to Los Angeles (LAX) did each of the legacy carriers (AA, UA, DL or US) have in May from JFK, and what was their average duration?

   ```{python}
   (flights
      .query("dest == 'LAX' and origin == 'JFK' and month == 5")
      .query("carrier in ['AA','UA','DL','US']")
      .groupby("carrier", as_index = False)
      .agg(
         n = ("flight", "size"),
         avg_air_time = ("air_time", np.mean)
      )
   )
   ```

2. Which plane (check the tail numbers) flew out of each New York airport the most?

   ```{python}
   (flights
      .dropna(subset=["tailnum"])
      .groupby(["origin","tailnum"])
      .size()
      .groupby("origin", group_keys=False)
      .nlargest(1, keep="all")
      .reset_index(name="n")
   )
   ```


3. Which 5 days should you consider flying on if you want to have the lowest possible average departure delay?

   ```{python}
   (flights
      .groupby(["year","month","day"], as_index=False)
      .agg(avg_dep_delay = ("dep_delay","mean"))
      .sort_values(["avg_dep_delay", "year", "month", "day"])
      .head(5)
   )
   ```


4. Which flight has the largest arrival delay as a percentage of its scheduled air time?

   ```{python}
   (flights
      .dropna(subset=["arr_delay"])
      .query("air_time > 0")
      .assign(
         arr_delay_pct = 100 * pd.col("arr_delay") / pd.col("air_time")
      )
      .nlargest(
         1, "arr_delay_pct", keep = "all"
      )
      [["month", "day", "year", "carrier", "flight", "origin", "dest", "arr_delay", "air_time", "arr_delay_pct"]]
   )
   ```
